text: DP-750 is Microsoft's associate-level exam for Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate. It validates exactly what this course covers past the fundamentals — environment setup, Unity Catalog governance, data preparation, and pipeline deployment.

Microsoft's own study guide lists four skill domains: environment setup, securing and governing Unity Catalog objects, preparing and processing data, and deploying and maintaining pipelines. The last two carry the most weight.
Map those domains onto this course and the pattern is direct — Chapters 2 through 5 carry most of the exam's real weight.
Scoring is a scaled score from 1 to 1000, with 700 or greater required to pass. Question count and duration vary by exam form — check the current exam page before you register.
The honest caveat: Microsoft revises its exam skill lists on its own schedule. Re-verify against Microsoft's own current study guide before you schedule this exam.
Next up: practice scenarios that put these four domains to work, spanning Unity Catalog governance through performance tuning.
